brixton.name: Brixton
brixton.funFact: The southern terminus of the Victoria line and one of the deepest-served corners of the network.

oval.name: Oval
oval.funFact: Named after the nearby Surrey County Cricket Ground; one of the first deep-level tube stations in the world.

kings-cross.name: King's Cross St. Pancras
kings-cross.funFact: The busiest interchange on the Underground, served by six lines.

victoria-stn.name: Victoria
victoria-stn.funFact: One of the busiest stations in the UK, the Victoria line platforms opened a century after the original.
